meta.description: Trim multiple sequence alignments using ClipKIT, trimAl, BMGE, Divvier, or HMMcleaner with mode selection guidance per downstream goal. Use when removing unreliable columns or contaminating residues before phylogenetic inference, HMM building, or selection analysis.
meta.executed: 7/7 inputs executed (ClipKIT 2.14.0, trimAl 1.4.1, BMGE 1.12 and 2.0, MACSE 2.07, IQ-TREE 2.4.0, PAML codeml 4.10.10, Biopython 1.88, DendroPy 5.0.13); partial tool coverage in inputs 4-6
meta.execution_note: All alignments are SYNTHETIC (IQ-TREE AliSim with indels from known trees, aligned with MAFFT L-INS-i; data/make_data.py) plus 10 replicate genes for an accuracy check. Not executable on this Windows machine and checked against documentation only: trimAl 1.5.1 release binary (fails to load), Divvier, HMMcleaner, Gblocks, T-Coffee/TCS, HMMER hmmbuild; PhyIN phyin.py was downloaded but the Skill's flags do not exist. Skill commands that failed (ClipKIT --output-format, BMGE commands on 2.0, examples/bmge_trim.py on 2.0, trimal_modes.py without trimal on PATH) are recorded verbatim and adapted.

scientific_integrity.detail: No output fabricated data, statistics or citations; all numbers came from runs on synthetic data. The Skill's own ClipKIT issue citations (#71, #88) are unverifiable and were flagged in Input 3 rather than repeated.

practice_boundaries.detail: Pure research alignment processing; nothing diagnoses, prescribes or triages an individual.

methodological_ground.detail: Outputs kept trimmed-vs-untrimmed sensitivity analyses, refused support-driven over-trimming (Input 7), did not column-trim branch-site input (Input 6) and corrected the Skill's residue-level TCS filter; no methodological fallacy remained in any delivered output.

code_usability.detail: All delivered code ran. Skill commands with wrong flags (ClipKIT --output-format, BMGE 2.0 -h/-t DNA) fail with clear errors or no output and were adapted per the Skill's introspect-and-adapt rule; shipped examples compile and run with the documented tool versions. Recorded as P1 correctness defects rather than unrunnable code.

functional_suitability.note: Completeness 3, correctness 1, appropriateness 3. Broad goal-driven coverage, but ClipKIT --output-format, Gblocks -b1=50%/-b2=85%, PhyIN -o/-w/-t, HMMcleaner --no-large-remove and TCS +keep (residues, not columns) are wrong; BMGE commands only work on 1.12; codeml '!' and MACSE export claims fail when run; ClipKIT issues #71/#88 do not document what is claimed.

reliability.note: Common Errors table and introspect-and-adapt rule; no output-exists check (BMGE 2.0 exits 0 with no file), no warning that trimming a concatenation invalidates partition charsets.

performance_context.note: 310-line SKILL.md loads TCS, MACSE, PhyIN, Gblocks and HMMcleaner detail up front; no references/ split.

agent_usability.note: Clear decision tables and strong pitfalls (kpic on unbalanced data, no trimming before selection tests); inconsistent thresholds (20%/40% rule vs 0.7 cap vs '20-30%'), recommended kpic-smart-gap default breaks its own 40% rule, -strictplus recommended for trees though trimAl marks it NJ-optimized.

human_usability.note: Usage guide has natural example prompts; description is tool-name heavy; handles off-spec goals by routing.

security.note: Local tools only, list-form subprocess with no shell or eval; no validation of alignment type or format before trimming.

maintainability.note: One example per tool, but no test data or expected output; examples assume BMGE.jar in cwd and trimal/divvier on PATH.

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger (4); progressive disclosure 2 (monolithic); composability 3 via related-skill routing; idempotency 3; escape hatches 3 (do not trim selection input or short genes).

recommendations.title: Fix commands whose flags do not exist
recommendations.problem: ClipKIT --output-format exits 2; Gblocks -b1=50%/-b2=85%, PhyIN -o/-w/-t, HMMcleaner --no-large-remove and TCS +keep column masking contradict each tool's documentation.
recommendations.root_cause: Commands were not checked against the current tools' help or documentation.
recommendations.fix: Use clipkit -of phylip; integer Gblocks b1/b2; python phyin.py -input -output -b -d -p; drop --no-large-remove; use seq_reformat -action +use_cons +keep '[5-9]'.

recommendations.title: BMGE commands silently fail on BMGE 2.0
recommendations.problem: With BMGE 2.0 the Skill's commands and examples/bmge_trim.py exit 0 printing help and write no alignment; the example then crashes on a missing trimmed.fasta.
recommendations.root_cause: The Skill says 'BMGE 1.12+' but uses 1.12-only syntax (-h entropy, -t DNA) that 2.0 changed.
recommendations.fix: Pin BMGE 1.12 or give 2.0 syntax (-t NT/CO, -e entropy, new defaults), and verify the output file exists and is non-empty after the call.

recommendations.title: Default kpic mode contradicts the 40% and 0.7 rules
recommendations.problem: kpic-smart-gap removed 48-51% of columns on all 10 replicate genes and on the deep matrix, so the Skill's rules would reject its own default even though its trees were accurate.
recommendations.root_cause: The aggressiveness rule was written for gap-based removal and does not account for kpic dropping singleton sites by design; thresholds of 20%, 20-30% and 40% coexist.
recommendations.fix: Reconcile to one threshold, state it applies to gap/entropy removal, and make the sensitivity-tree comparison the deciding test for kpic modes.

recommendations.title: Correct selection-analysis post-processing claims
recommendations.problem: PAML codeml 4.10.10 rejects '!' instead of treating it as missing; the MACSE exportAlignment command leaves '!' in place; t_coffee -evaluate writes <name>.score_ascii rather than stdout.
recommendations.root_cause: Tool behaviour was asserted without running it.
recommendations.fix: Always replace '!' before codeml; add -codonForInternalFS --- (or -charForRemainingFS -) to the MACSE export; read the .score_ascii file produced by -evaluate.

recommendations.title: Replace unverifiable ClipKIT issue citations
recommendations.problem: ClipKIT issue #71 is a dependabot dependency bump and #88 does not exist.
recommendations.root_cause: Citation not checked against the repository.
recommendations.fix: Remove the issue numbers or cite the Steenwyk et al. 2020 text that describes kpic behaviour.

recommendations.title: Warn that trimming a concatenation breaks charsets
recommendations.problem: Trimming the concatenated matrix leaves the partition file pointing past the alignment end (IQ-TREE: Too large site ID).
recommendations.root_cause: The supermatrix recommendation ignores partition bookkeeping.
recommendations.fix: Recommend trimming per locus and rebuilding charsets, or mapping kept columns back through the --log file.

recommendations.title: Correct --log and -colnumbering format text
recommendations.problem: ClipKIT logs are space-separated with named site classes, and trimAl prints a '#ColumnsMap' tab prefix before the comma list.
recommendations.root_cause: Formats described from memory rather than from output.
recommendations.fix: Show a real first line of each file and a two-line parser for each.

recommendations.title: Re-examine -strictplus for ML tree input
recommendations.problem: trimAl's help marks -strictplus as optimized for Neighbour Joining (automated1 for ML), and it was the only mode that lost accuracy in the replicate check (total RF 10).
recommendations.root_cause: Mode recommendation not aligned with the tool's documentation.
recommendations.fix: Recommend -gappyout or explicit -strict for ML input and keep -strictplus for NJ.

recommendations.title: Split tool-specific detail into references
recommendations.problem: All TCS, MACSE, PhyIN, Gblocks and HMMcleaner material is inline in a 310-line SKILL.md.
recommendations.fix: Keep the decision tables in SKILL.md and move per-tool sections to references/.
